data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims reserves at the start of the year were GBP 308.1m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle for underwriting years up to 2014 indicates a net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 2.95m (c.0.96% of opening reserves), i.e. a small strengthening. Management commentary notes adverse development principally on the Treaty class while older years of Property, Special Lines and Liability showed better-than-expected development. The calculation is derived from the published gross claims development table as the movement note in the accounts reports only net (post-reinsurance) deterioration.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 121,917k (2015 - GBP 99,481) is a deterioration of GBP 6,859k (2015 - deterioration of GBP 29,646k) to the claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to adverse developments in prior year reserves on the Treaty class.
In addition, the claims development on the Property, Special Lines and Liability accounts on the older years of account has been better than expected.

The losses on the 2015 and 2016 years of account are driven by new catastrophe and large losses in the year, primarily on the Property, Special Lines and Treaty classes, and attritional loss development on the Property and Personal Accident & Sickness lines.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding comparative 2015). Prior-year movement (gross) computed from the published GROSS claims development triangle (note 20) by comparing current estimates to the previous diagonal for underwriting years 2011-2014 and excluding 2015 and 2016 per instructions. The accounts' explicit narrative (note 7) reports a net deterioration figure; because that figure is net of reinsurance and the requirement is for GROSS PYD, the triangle was used as the primary source. All monetary values in statements were presented in thousands; amounts above converted to millions. Some LOB-specific prior-year movements are described qualitatively only (no gross amounts disclosed), so amounts are null where not quantified.
